articles.headline: Judge OK's RJ Luis Jr. to join LSU; lawyer says Will Wade now in 'crosshairs'
articles.description: RJ Luis Jr. is eligible to play and practice with LSU through a temporary injunction signed by a Louisiana judge Wednesday.

images.name: RJ Luis Jr. [600x600]
images.caption: RJ Luis Jr. was granted an injunction by a Louisiana court allowing him to play another year of college basketball at LSU. The SEC's new rules put everything into jeopardy.

articles.headline: Lewis Uvwo, the No. 1 center in 2027, commits to Providence
articles.description: Lewis Uvwo, the No. 1 center in the class of 2027, committed to Providence on Wednesday, giving the Friars their highest-ranked recruit in at least 20 years.

articles.headline: Big Ten limits schools' involvement in outside NIL deals

articles.headline: Asa Montgomery picks 'dream school' in committing to Duke
